images.section: 镜光时刻 · 6 米巨镜装置
images.title: The MIRROR HOUR · 6m Glaze Installation
images.prompt: Architectural installation photograph in a French-quarter courtyard in Shanghai (Anfu Road style — emerald green window frames, century-old plane trees, French colonial architecture). Center of the courtyard: a giant 6-meter-tall sculptural mirror installation, shaped like a curved petal — the mirror surface is a gradient rose-gold to pink, with a subtle 'glaze' wet-look finish that reflects everything around it. Surrounding the installation: tall vases of fresh pink garden roses, small marble cocktail tables, a few young Asian women in chic outfits taking photos. Late afternoon golden hour light catching the mirror's surface. Mood: cinematic, luxurious, fashion magazine spread. Style: high-end retail visualization, photoreal, Vogue editorial quality. Absolutely no text. Aspect 3:2.
images.purpose: Replace previous AURA CAFÉ exterior — new visual anchor for white-space strategy

images.section: RAC BAR 安福路院落改造
images.title: RAC BAR Anfu Lu × Kérastase Pop-Up
images.prompt: Architectural visualization of a French-quarter Shanghai courtyard café (inspired by RAC BAR on Anfu Lu): emerald-green wooden window frames, century-old plane tree shadow on stone walls, vintage cobblestone courtyard. The courtyard has been transformed into a pink rose garden pop-up: pink petals scattered on stone floor, fresh pink rose arrangements in tall classical urns, a small French bistro table set with rose-gold cutlery, an elegant gilt mirror leaning against the green wall. A small repurposed security-booth-turned-coffee-window in the foreground, decorated with hanging wisteria of pink roses. Late afternoon warm light filtering through plane tree leaves. Mood: French Parisian garden meets Shanghai elegance. Style: editorial architecture photography, hyper-realistic. Absolutely no text. Aspect 3:2.
images.purpose: Show the RAC BAR Anfu Lu courtyard transformation

images.title: FASCINO × Kérastase Wave 1 morning

images.title: ConnieHe × Kérastase Wave 2 evening
images.prompt: Modern minimalist café interior at the Westbund waterfront, Shanghai: floor-to-ceiling glass walls overlooking the Huangpu River at sunset, polished concrete and brushed-brass design (inspired by Atelier Deshaus), long marble bar counter. The bar is dressed in a Kérastase pop-up theme: pink rose petals scattered, rose-gold accent ribbons, elegant cake displays of pink chiffon cakes and rose gelato in glass cloches. A pair of Asian women in their early 20s sitting at the bar, sharing a tray of desserts and pink rose lattes, engaged in intimate laugh. Soft golden hour light streaming in. Mood: West Bund elegance meets Bestie tea-time. Style: high-end editorial, hyper-realistic. Absolutely no text. Aspect 3:2.

images.section: Glass Hair · 玻璃发文化锚
images.title: Glass Hair Visualization
images.prompt: Macro hair photography. Extreme close-up of long luminous black East Asian hair, captured at the moment of motion mid-flip. The hair surface has a hyper-real mirror-like quality — like polished obsidian or wet glass — every individual strand reflecting tiny points of warm light, creating a glass-like glaze effect. Soft pink rose petals are caught mid-air around the flying hair. Background: out-of-focus rose-gold and cream gradient bokeh. Lighting: dramatic side-light to maximize the glass-hair gleam. Style: ultra-detail beauty editorial close-up, magazine cover quality. Absolutely no text. Aspect 1:1.
images.purpose: Visual anchor for Glass Hair / 玻璃发 cultural concept

images.section: 假货焦虑解决方案 · 货源溯源
images.title: Anti-Counterfeit Authentication
images.prompt: Editorial product photograph showing the back of a luxury rose-gold ceramic hair mask jar held by an elegant feminine hand with pearl-pink manicure. The hand is using a smartphone (out of focus in foreground) with a glowing UI accent that suggests scanning a small holographic anchor seal embossed on the jar's back — the seal has a luxurious metallic sheen. The aesthetic is calm, trustworthy, and luxury. Background: soft cream marble with scattered fresh pink rose petals. Mood: 'verify, then trust.' Style: high-end e-commerce editorial photography, hyper-realistic. Absolutely no readable text or QR code dots — just an abstract luxurious authentication mark. Aspect 1:1.

images.section: Yang Mi style KV — Mirror Hour
images.title: Brand Ambassador KV · Mirror Hour Edition
images.prompt: Vertical luxury celebrity portrait, magazine cover format. A stunning East Asian woman in her early 30s, with iconic flowing long luminous black hair captured mid-flow — the hair has an extreme mirror-like glass-glaze quality reflecting soft rose-gold light. She wears an elegant black silk gown with a deep neckline, looking directly at camera with confident, slightly enigmatic gaze. She is positioned in a French-quarter courtyard at sunset (similar to Anfu Lu Shanghai) — emerald-green window frames blurred behind her, pink garden roses in tall vases. A halo of warm sunset light around her like a personal spotlight. She holds a transparent pink hair perfume bottle in one hand, and a rose-gold compact mirror in the other. Color palette: deep burgundy / glaze pink / rose gold / black. Style: luxury fashion magazine cover, dramatic moody cinematic lighting, hyper-realistic. NOT modeled after any specific real celebrity — generic Asian beauty archetype. Absolutely no text. Aspect 2:3.
